summary: Neuraxis, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock for Q2 2026. The dividend will be paid in common stock, with approximately 80,463 shares to be issued at a conversion price of $2.38 per share, payable on July 29, 2026 to holders of record on July 21, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu. This is a routine preferred stock dividend payment, not a special situation event.
